items.title: computer
items.description_zh: 给你的代理人一台电脑👾

items.title: loopx
items.description: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams. Agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs, and verifiable handoffs.
items.description_zh: 适用于长期运行的 AI 代理团队的轻量级循环工程状态内核。跨 Codex、Claude Code 和其他编码代理的代理循环不可知，具有持久目标、配额感知自动唤醒、可执行待办事项、证据日志和可验证的切换。

items.title: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
items.description_zh: TangentDB Agent Memory 是 AI Agent 的团队级内存中心，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可重用的内存资产（聊天内存、技能、LLM-Wiki、代码图），并在代理和框架之间进行管理、共享和配备。

items.title: system-design-primer
items.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
items.description_zh: 了解如何设计大型系统。准备系统设计面试。包括 Anki 抽认卡。

items.title: pdf-inspector
items.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.
items.description_zh: 用于 PDF 检查、分类和文本提取的快速 Rust 库。智能检测扫描 PDF 与基于文本的 PDF，以实现智能路由决策。

items.title: DeepSeek-Reasonix
items.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek-适用于您终端的原生 AI 编码代理。围绕前缀缓存稳定性进行设计 - 让它运行。

items.title: agent-skills
items.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
items.description_zh: AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能。

items.title: superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.description_zh: 有效的代理技能框架和软件开发方法。

items.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
items.description_zh: 我们为您编写可重复使用的计算机视觉工具。 💜

items.title: tailwindcss
items.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
items.description_zh: 用于快速 UI 开发的实用程序优先 CSS 框架。

items.title: ADR
items.description: ADR secures enterprise AI agents through observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection. Deployed at Uber.
items.description_zh: ADR 通过可观察性、安全基准测试和威胁检测来保护企业 AI 代理。部署在 Uber。
